architecture_cause.claim: Shared-head recurrent supervision is a plausible contributor, not a demonstrated cause.

arithmetic_relative_deficit.claim: On the retained evaluation (fit size not authenticated), the paired J-minus-logit effect for task-defined arithmetic intermediate-token readout is below zero at loops 1; inconclusive at loops 2, 3, 4; this is local arithmetic with unfrozen evaluation lineage.
arithmetic_relative_deficit.estimand: item-mean of own-name hit@10 at any layer in a loop minus the mean of the same any-layer statistic over matched control names

b300_validation.claim: The current validation artifact is hash-bound but does not satisfy both the exclusively-B300 and controller-approved immutable-image gates.

checkpoint_comparison.claim: Across the retained base, Thinking, and RLTT rows, distributional trends are multihop KL decreases and JS decreases, order-ops KL mixed and JS mixed; categorical trends are multihop top-1 agreement mixed, order-ops top-1 agreement mixed. The metrics are heterogeneous, so no blanket agreement-improvement claim is made.
checkpoint_comparison.estimand: exit-to-final KL, JS, entropy, final-token rank, and top-1 agreement
checkpoint_comparison.population: retained base, Thinking, and RLTT checkpoint evaluation stimuli

cross_loop_association.claim: Cross-loop matrices are descriptive and do not identify a causal mechanism.

estimator_independence.claim: The matched 2x2 position-by-reduction control has not been run.

instrumentation.claim: Current-source validation passes the complete M1-M5 numerical gate; comparison count, source identities, and bit-exact status are recorded separately.

large_fit_robustness.claim: Nested fits do not establish behavior at n=1000 or fixed-n variability.

lens_free_exit_agreement.claim: Item-weighted exit agreement is descriptive on the retained 93/55-stimulus populations; it is not current-generation evidence.

local_eventual_convergence.claim: Mean KL from the local-exit readout to the eventual-exit readout does not decrease strictly over loops 1-3 on a retained historical comparison with unfrozen evaluation lineage.
